Any wobble in funding appetite for the whole AI-infra chain becomes existential for OpenAI specifically, and OpenAI-linked demand is a load-bearing assumption for hyperscaler/neocloud capex plans. 影响: 这么远、这么大的烧钱预测说明 OpenAI 认为自己整个十年都会持续深度失血，得靠不断融大轮或者靠微软、甲骨文这类伙伴扛资本开支才能撑下去。一旦整条 AI 基建链的融资胃口出问题，OpenAI 首当其冲，而超大规模厂商和 neocloud 的 capex 计划又恰好建立在「OpenAI 需求会一直在」这个假设上。

Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)

90d low:  1.95%
Move:     +66bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield hit 2.61% on 2026-09-17, up 0.66pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.95%.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-09-17 升至 2.61%，较过去 90 天低点 1.95% 上升了 0.66 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate for long-duration AI capex bets — a rise this fast tightens financial conditions and raises the hurdle rate for data-center buildouts funded on projected future cash flows. C10 mirrors C7's structure and escalates MED→HIGH at 2x the trigger off the same trailing-90 low.

影响:
实际收益率是长久期 AI capex 押注的贴现率——涨得这么快会收紧金融条件，抬高那些靠未来现金流预期融资的数据中心项目的门槛。C10 和 C7 结构一致，同样以过去 90 天低点为基准，涨幅达到触发值 2 倍时从 MED 升到 HIGH。

The 10-year real (TIPS) yield hit 2.68%, above the 2.5% stress threshold, as of 2026-09-16.

10年期实际（TIPS）收益率在 2026-09-16 达到 2.68%，超过 2.5% 的压力阈值。

Rising real yields raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly. This is a background liquidity headwind, not company-specific, but it compounds with credit-spread widening (C7) to squeeze the whole AI-infra trade.

影响:

OpenAI Considers Pre-IPO Funding Round at More Than $1.2 Trillion Valuation

The ChatGPT maker has had preliminary investor discussions about a new raise. It is likely to go public next year.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
OpenAI is reportedly in early talks with investors about a pre-IPO funding round that would value the company above $1.2 trillion, with a public listing possibly following next year.

内容:
据报道，OpenAI 已与投资者就一轮 IPO 前融资进行初步接触，估值可能超过 $1.2 trillion，并可能在明年上市。

Why it matters:
A valuation this size, still built entirely on private funding rounds rather than public-market discipline, is the clearest marker of how much capital the AI buildout depends on OpenAI's growth story holding up. A pre-IPO round this large also foreshadows a future IPO stress-test of that valuation — if OpenAI's burn/revenue metrics (tracked separately by C3) don't support it, the repricing risk cascades to every hyperscaler and neocloud whose capex plans assume OpenAI demand keeps scaling.

影响:
这么高的估值目前完全建立在私募轮基础上，没有经过公开市场的检验，正是整个 AI 投入依赖 OpenAI 增长故事撑住的最直接体现。这轮 IPO 前融资本身也预示着未来 IPO 会对这个估值做一次压力测试——如果 OpenAI 的烧钱/营收指标（C3 单独跟踪）撑不住，重新定价的风险会传导到所有把资本开支计划建立在 OpenAI 需求持续扩张假设上的超大规模厂商和 neocloud。

Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)

Current:  2.60%
90d low:  1.93%
Move:     +67bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield hit 2.60pp on 2026-09-14, up 0.67pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.93pp — a rise flagged by C10's REAL_YIELD_SPIKE trigger.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-09-14 达到 2.60pp，较过去 90 天低点 1.93pp 上升 0.67pp，触发了 C10 的 REAL_YIELD_SPIKE。

Why it matters:
Real yields this high raise the discount rate applied to long-duration AI-capex cash flows that mostly land years out, directly compressing the valuation these bets depend on. A 0.67pp move off the recent low crossing C10's trigger threshold signals liquidity is tightening under the AI trade, not just around it.

影响:
实际收益率走高会提高远期现金流的折现率，而 AI capex 的回报大多要等好几年后才兑现，这直接压低这类投资的估值。这次 0.67pp 的涨幅已经越过 C10 的触发线，说明流动性收紧不只是发生在 AI 交易外围，而是已经影响到它本身。

10年期 TIPS 实际收益率从 90 天低点 1.93% 跳升至 2.60%（截至 2026-09-11），涨幅 0.67 个百分点。

C10 escalates from MED to HIGH once the rise hits 2x the trigger off the trailing low — real yields spiking this fast tightens financial conditions and raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows, squeezing exactly the names funding growth with debt.

影响:
C10 的规则是涨幅达到触发线 2 倍就从 MED 升级到 HIGH。实际收益率这么快拉升会收紧金融条件，抬高长久期 AI capex 现金流的折现率，对靠举债扩张的公司压力尤其大。
